title: roster
summary: Benilla defines the SMSG_CHAR_ENUM entry (BuildEnumData field order incl. 19 equipment slots + first-bag pair), CMSG_CHAR_CREATE (name + 9 appearance/identity bytes), and the create/delete result codes (0x2E success, 0x31 name-in-use, 0x34 server-limit, 0x39 delete-success). MSUI's Net/Character.Read is a field-exact port, WorldSession.CreateCharacter/DeleteCharacter send the same bodies and wait on the same result bytes, and Program.CharCreate.cs maps result bytes to GlueStrings text.
